Um interface.question: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 _____ 6.4.1
Um interface.fact: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 Section 6.4.1. These restrictions are intended to exclude non-sensical BTS configurations and are described in GSM 05.02 Section 6.5.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: These restrictions are intended to exclude non-sensical BTS configurations and are described in GSM 05.02 _____ 6.5
Um interface.fact: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 Section 6.4.1. These restrictions are intended to exclude non-sensical BTS configurations and are described in GSM 05.02 Section 6.5.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The most common combinations are: _____ I: TCH/F + FACCH/F + SACCH
Um interface.fact: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 Section 6.4.1. Additionally, only certain of these combinations are allowed on certain timeslots or carriers and only certain sets of combinations can coexist in a given BTS.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination II: TCH/H + _____/H + SACCH
Um interface.fact: The most common combinations are: Combination I: TCH/F + FACCH/F + SACCH. Combination II: TCH/H + FACCH/H + SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination III: 2 TCH/H + 2 _____/H + 2 SACCH
Um interface.fact: Combination II: TCH/H + FACCH/H + SACCH. Combination III: 2 TCH/H + 2 FACCH/H + 2 SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination IV: _____ + SCH + BCCH + CCCH
Um interface.fact: Combination IV: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH. Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination V: _____ + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH
Um interface.fact: Combination IV: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH. Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: [(5x1)+(5x1)+(1x4)+(3x4)+(4x4)+(2x4)+1idle=51frame multiframe] This is the typical C0T0 combination for small cells, which allows the BTS to trade unnecessary _____ capacity for a pool of 4 SDCCHs
Um interface.fact: Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH. [(5x1)+(5x1)+(1x4)+(3x4)+(4x4)+(2x4)+1idle=51frame multiframe] This is the typical C0T0 combination for small cells, which allows the BTS to trade unnecessary CCCH capacity for a pool of 4 SDCCHs.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination VI: _____ + CCCH
Um interface.fact: Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH. Combination VI: BCCH + CCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This combination is used to provide additional _____ capacity in large cells
Um interface.fact: [(5x1)+(5x1)+(1x4)+(3x4)+(4x4)+(2x4)+1idle=51frame multiframe] This is the typical C0T0 combination for small cells, which allows the BTS to trade unnecessary CCCH capacity for a pool of 4 SDCCHs. Combination VI: BCCH + CCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination VII: 8 _____ + 4 SACCH.[(8x4)+(4x4)+3idle=51frame multiframe] This combination is used to provide additional SDCCH capacity in medium and large cells
Um interface.fact: Combination VII: 8 SDCCH + 4 SACCH.[(8x4)+(4x4)+3idle=51frame multiframe] This combination is used to provide additional SDCCH capacity in medium and large cells.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: All of these transactions are described in GSM 04.08 _____ 3-7
Um interface.fact: All of these transactions are described in GSM 04.08 Sections 3-7.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The Um radio resource establishment procedure is defined in GSM 04.08 _____ 3.3 and this is the basic medium access procedure for Um
Um interface.fact: All of these transactions are described in GSM 04.08 Sections 3-7. The Um radio resource establishment procedure is defined in GSM 04.08 Section 3.3 and this is the basic medium access procedure for Um.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This procedure uses the _____ (PCH and AGCH) as a unicast downlink and the RACH as a shared uplink
Um interface.fact: This procedure uses the CCCH (PCH and AGCH) as a unicast downlink and the RACH as a shared uplink.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: In the simplest form, the steps of the transaction are: _____
Um interface.fact: In the simplest form, the steps of the transaction are: Paging. The network sends a RR Paging Request message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network sends a RR _____ message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address
Um interface.fact: The network sends a RR Paging Request message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: GSM does not allow paging by IMEI (GSM 04.08 _____ 9.1.22.3 as exception to the definition in 10.5.1.4)
Um interface.fact: The network sends a RR Paging Request message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address. GSM does not allow paging by IMEI (GSM 04.08 Section 9.1.22.3 as exception to the definition in 10.5.1.4).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The mobile station sends a burst on the _____
Um interface.fact: The mobile station sends a burst on the RACH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This burst encodes an 8-bit transaction tag and the _____ of the serving BTS
Um interface.fact: This burst encodes an 8-bit transaction tag and the BSIC of the serving BTS.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: In L3, this tag is presented as the RR _____ message (GSM 04.08 9.1.8)
Um interface.fact: In L3, this tag is presented as the RR Channel Request message (GSM 04.08 9.1.8).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The mobile also records the _____ clock state at the time the RACH burst is transmitted
Um interface.fact: The mobile also records the TDMA clock state at the time the RACH burst is transmitted. This message is addressed to the MS by inclusion of the 8-bit tag from the corresponding RACH burst and a time-stamp indicating the TDMA clock state when the RACH burst was received.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This message is addressed to the MS by inclusion of the 8-bit tag from the corresponding _____ burst and a time-stamp indicating the TDMA clock state when the RACH burst was received
Um interface.fact: The mobile also records the TDMA clock state at the time the RACH burst is transmitted. This message is addressed to the MS by inclusion of the 8-bit tag from the corresponding RACH burst and a time-stamp indicating the TDMA clock state when the RACH burst was received.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: On the AGCH, the network sends the RR _____ message (GSM 04.08 Section 9.1.18) for a dedicated channel, usually an SDCCH
Um interface.fact: On the AGCH, the network sends the RR Immediate Assignment message (GSM 04.08 Section 9.1.18) for a dedicated channel, usually an SDCCH. If no dedicated channel is available for assignment, the BTS can instead respond with the RR Immediate Assignment Reject message, which is similarly addressed and contains a hold-off time for the next access attempt.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: If no dedicated channel is available for assignment, the BTS can instead respond with the RR _____ message, which is similarly addressed and contains a hold-off time for the next access attempt
Um interface.fact: If no dedicated channel is available for assignment, the BTS can instead respond with the RR Immediate Assignment Reject message, which is similarly addressed and contains a hold-off time for the next access attempt.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Note that there is a small but non-zero probability that two MSs send identical _____ bursts at the same time in step 2
Um interface.fact: If the RACH burst of step 2 is not answered with an assignment or assignment reject in step 3 within a given timeout period (usually on the order of 0.5 second), the handset will repeat step 2 after a small random delay. Note that there is a small but non-zero probability that two MSs send identical RACH bursts at the same time in step 2.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: If these _____ bursts arrive at the BTS with comparable power, the resulting sum of radio signals will not be demodulable and both MSs will move to step 4
Um interface.fact: If the RACH burst of step 2 is not answered with an assignment or assignment reject in step 3 within a given timeout period (usually on the order of 0.5 second), the handset will repeat step 2 after a small random delay. Note that there is a small but non-zero probability that two MSs send identical RACH bursts at the same time in step 2.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: However, if there is a sufficient difference in power, the BTS will see and answer the more powerful _____ burst
Um interface.fact: Note that there is a small but non-zero probability that two MSs send identical RACH bursts at the same time in step 2. If these RACH bursts arrive at the BTS with comparable power, the resulting sum of radio signals will not be demodulable and both MSs will move to step 4.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This procedure normally is performed when the MS powers up or enters a new _____ area but may also be performed at other times as described in the specifications
Um interface.fact: This procedure normally is performed when the MS powers up or enters a new Location area but may also be performed at other times as described in the specifications. On the newly set up dedicated channel, the MS sends the MM Location Updating Request message containing either an IMSI or TMSI.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: On the newly established dedicated channel, the MS sends the MM _____ message containing either an IMSI or TMSI
Um interface.fact: On the newly set up dedicated channel, the MS sends the MM Location Updating Request message containing either an IMSI or TMSI.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network verifies the mobile identity in the HLR or VLR and responds with the MM _____ message
Um interface.fact: The network verifies the mobile identity in the HLR or VLR and responds with the MM Location Updating Accept message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network closes the Dm channel by sending the RR _____ message
Um interface.fact: The network closes the Dm channel by sending the RR Channel Release message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: In its simplest form, the steps of the transaction are: The MS initiates the radio channel establishment procedure and is assigned to a Dm channel, usually an _____
Um interface.fact: In its simplest form, the steps of the transaction are: The MS initiates the radio channel establishment procedure and is assigned to a Dm channel, usually an SDCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The first message sent on the new Dm is the MM _____ service Request, sent by the MS
Um interface.fact: The first message sent on the new Dm is the MM Connection Mode service Request, sent by the MS. The network verifies the subscriber's provisioning in the HLR and responds with the MM Connection Mode Service Accept message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This message contains a subscriber ID (_____ or TMSI) and a description of the requested service, in this case MOC
Um interface.fact: This message contains a subscriber ID (IMSI or TMSI) and a description of the requested service, in this case MOC.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network verifies the subscriber's provisioning in the HLR and responds with the MM _____ message
Um interface.fact: The network verifies the subscriber's provisioning in the HLR and responds with the MM Connection Mode Service Accept message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: In most networks MM establishment is performed with authentication and ciphering transactions at this point.) The MS sends the CC _____ message, which contains the called party number
Um interface.fact: In most networks MM establishment is performed with authentication and ciphering transactions at this point.) The MS sends the CC Setup message, which contains the called party number.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Assuming the called party number is valid, network response with the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: Assuming the called party number is valid, network response with the CC Call Proceeding message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network sends an RR _____ message to move the transaction off of the SDCCH and onto a TCH+FACCH
Um interface.fact: The network sends an RR Assignment message to move the transaction off of the SDCCH and onto a TCH+FACCH. Once the MS has acquired the timing on the TCH+FACCH, it responds on the new FACCH with the RR Assignment Complete message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: From this point on, all control transactions are on the _____
Um interface.fact: The network sends an RR Assignment message to move the transaction off of the SDCCH and onto a TCH+FACCH. Once the MS has acquired the timing on the TCH+FACCH, it responds on the new FACCH with the RR Assignment Complete message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Once the MS has acquired the timing on the TCH+FACCH, it responds on the new FACCH with the RR _____ message
Um interface.fact: Once the MS has acquired the timing on the TCH+FACCH, it responds on the new FACCH with the RR Assignment Complete message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: When alerting is verified at the called destination, the network sends the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: When alerting is verified at the called destination, the network sends the CC Alerting message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: When the called party answers, the network sends the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: When the called party answers, the network sends the CC Connect message. The MS response with the CC Connect Acknowledge message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS response with the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: The MS response with the CC Connect Acknowledge message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The TCH+_____ assignment can occur at any time during the transaction, depending on the configuration of the network
Um interface.fact: The TCH+FACCH assignment can occur at any time during the transaction, depending on the configuration of the network. The network assigns the TCH+FACCH after sending CC Call Proceeding and completes call setup on the FACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: There are three common approaches: _____
Um interface.fact: There are three common approaches: Early Assignment.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network assigns the TCH+FACCH after sending CC _____ and completes call setup on the FACCH
Um interface.fact: The network assigns the TCH+FACCH after sending CC Call Proceeding and completes call setup on the FACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network does not assign the TCH+_____ until after alerting has started
Um interface.fact: The network assigns the TCH+FACCH after sending CC Call Proceeding and completes call setup on the FACCH. The network does not assign the TCH+FACCH until after alerting has started.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network makes an immediate assignment to the TCH+_____ in the initial RR establishment and performs the entire transaction on the FACCH
Um interface.fact: The network does not assign the TCH+FACCH until after alerting has started. The network makes an immediate assignment to the TCH+FACCH in the initial RR establishment and performs the entire transaction on the FACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Because immediate assignment starts the FACCH in a signaling-only mode, the network must send the RR _____ message at some point to enable the TCH part of the channel
Um interface.fact: Because immediate assignment starts the FACCH in a signaling-only mode, the network must send the RR Channel Mode Modify message at some point to enable the TCH part of the channel.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network initiates the radio channel establishment procedure and assigns the MS to a Dm channel, usually an _____
Um interface.fact: The SDCCH is not used. The network initiates the radio channel establishment procedure and assigns the MS to a Dm channel, usually an SDCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS sends the first message on the new Dm, which is the RR _____ message
Um interface.fact: The MS sends the first message on the new Dm, which is the RR Paging Response message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This message contains a mobile identity (_____ or TMSI) and also implies a connection attempt in the MM sublayer
Um interface.fact: This message contains a mobile identity (IMSI or TMSI) and also implies a connection attempt in the MM sublayer.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network can initiate authentication and ciphering at this point, but in the simplest case the network can just send the CC _____ message to initiate Q.931-style call control
Um interface.fact: The network can initiate authentication and ciphering at this point, but in the simplest case the network can just send the CC Setup message to initiate Q.931-style call control.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS responds with _____
Um interface.fact: The MS responds with CC Call Confirmed.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS starts alerting (ringing, etc.) and sends the CC _____ message to the network
Um interface.fact: The MS starts alerting (ringing, etc.) and sends the CC Alerting message to the network.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: When the subscriber answers, the MS sends the CC _____ message to the network
Um interface.fact: When the subscriber answers, the MS sends the CC Connect message to the network. The network response with the CC Connect Acknowledge message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network response with the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: The network response with the CC Connect Acknowledge message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: As in the MOC, the TCH+_____ assignment can happen at any time, with the three common techniques being early, late and very early assignment
Um interface.fact: As in the MOC, the TCH+FACCH assignment can happen at any time, with the three common techniques being early, late and very early assignment.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Party A sends the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: Party A sends the CC Disconnect message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Party B responds with the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: Party B responds with the CC Release message. Party A responds with the CC Release Complete message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Party A responds with the CC _____ message
Um interface.fact: Party A responds with the CC Release Complete message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network releases the RR connection with the RR _____ message
Um interface.fact: The network releases the RR connection with the RR Channel Release message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: L2 is normally LAPDm, although GPRS-attached devices may use _____ link control (LLC, GSM 04.64)
Um interface.fact: L2 is normally LAPDm, although GPRS-attached devices may use Logical link control (LLC, GSM 04.64).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: L3, the connection layer, defined in GSM 04.11 _____ 5
Um interface.fact: L3, the connection layer, defined in GSM 04.11 Section 5. L4, the relay layer, defined in GSM 04.11 Section 6.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: L4, the relay layer, defined in GSM 04.11 _____ 6
Um interface.fact: L3, the connection layer, defined in GSM 04.11 Section 5. L4, the relay layer, defined in GSM 04.11 Section 6.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This layer terminates in the _____
Um interface.fact: This layer terminates in the SMSC.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS sends a CM _____, The MS initiates multiframe mode in SAP3 with the normal LAPDm SABM procedure
Um interface.fact: The MS sends a CM Service Request, The MS initiates multiframe mode in SAP3 with the normal LAPDm SABM procedure.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS sends a CP-DATA message (L3, GSM 04.11 _____ 7.2.1), which carries an RP-DATA message (L4, GSM 04.11 Section 7.3.1) in its RPDU
Um interface.fact: The MS sends a CP-DATA message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.1), which carries an RP-DATA message (L4, GSM 04.11 Section 7.3.1) in its RPDU. The network responds with a CP-ACK message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.2).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network responds with a CP-ACK message (L3, GSM 04.11 _____ 7.2.2)
Um interface.fact: The MS sends a CP-DATA message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.1), which carries an RP-DATA message (L4, GSM 04.11 Section 7.3.1) in its RPDU. The network responds with a CP-ACK message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.2).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MSC responds with an RP-ACK message (L4, GSM 04.11 _____ 7.3.3)
Um interface.fact: The MS sends a CP-DATA message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.1), which carries an RP-DATA message (L4, GSM 04.11 Section 7.3.1) in its RPDU. The network responds with a CP-ACK message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.2).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network delivers the _____ to the MSC
Um interface.fact: The MS sends a CP-DATA message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.1), which carries an RP-DATA message (L4, GSM 04.11 Section 7.3.1) in its RPDU. The network delivers the RPDU to the MSC.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network sends a CP-_____ message to the MS, carrying the RP-ACK payload in its RPDU
Um interface.fact: The network sends a CP-DATA message to the MS, carrying the RP-ACK payload in its RPDU.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network releases the SDCCH with the RR _____ message
Um interface.fact: The network releases the SDCCH with the RR Channel Release message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS establishes an _____ using the standard RR paging response procedure, which implies a CC sublayer connection
Um interface.fact: The network releases the SDCCH with the RR Channel Release message. The MS establishes an SDCCH using the standard RR paging response procedure, which implies a CC sublayer connection.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network sends the RP-_____ message as the RPDU in a CP-DATA message
Um interface.fact: The network sends the RP-DATA message as the RPDU in a CP-DATA message. The MS sends a CP-DATA message to the network containing an RP-ACK message in the RPDU.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS sends a CP-_____ message to the network containing an RP-ACK message in the RPDU
Um interface.fact: The MS sends a CP-DATA message (L3, GSM 04.11 Section 7.2.1), which carries an RP-DATA message (L4, GSM 04.11 Section 7.3.1) in its RPDU.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Copies of Ki are held in the SIM and in the _____ (AuC), a component of the HLR
Um interface.fact: Copies of Ki are held in the SIM and in the Authentication Center (AuC), a component of the HLR.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This oversight allows for false basestation attacks, such as those implemented in an _____ catcher
Um interface.fact: This oversight allows for false basestation attacks, such as those implemented in an IMSI catcher.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network sends RAND to the MS in the MM _____ message
Um interface.fact: The network sends RAND to the MS in the MM Authentication Request message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS forms a 32-bit hash value called _____ by encrypting RAND with an algorithm called A3, using Ki as a key
Um interface.fact: The MS forms a 32-bit hash value called SRES by encrypting RAND with an algorithm called A3, using Ki as a key. The network performs an identical SRES calculation.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network performs an identical _____ calculation
Um interface.fact: The MS forms a 32-bit hash value called SRES by encrypting RAND with an algorithm called A3, using Ki as a key. The network performs an identical SRES calculation.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network compares its calculated _____ value to the value returned by the MS
Um interface.fact: The MS forms a 32-bit hash value called SRES by encrypting RAND with an algorithm called A3, using Ki as a key. The network performs an identical SRES calculation.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS sends back its SRES value in the RR _____ message
Um interface.fact: The MS sends back its SRES value in the RR Authentication Response message.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Both the MS and the network also compute a 64-bit ciphering key, Kc, from _____ and Ki using the A8 algorithm
Um interface.fact: Both the MS and the network also compute a 64-bit ciphering key, Kc, from RAND and Ki using the A8 algorithm.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: A typical GSM transaction also includes LAPDm idle frames and _____ system information messages at predictable times, affording a Known plaintext attack
Um interface.fact: A typical GSM transaction also includes LAPDm idle frames and SACCH system information messages at predictable times, affording a Known plaintext attack.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Ciphering is initiated with the RR _____ message, which indicates the A5 variant to be used
Um interface.fact: Ciphering is initiated with the RR Ciphering Mode Command message, which indicates the A5 variant to be used.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The MS starts ciphering and responds with the RR _____ message in ciphertext
Um interface.fact: The MS starts ciphering and responds with the RR Ciphering Mode Complete message in ciphertext.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network is expected to deny service to any MS that does not support either A5/1 or A5/2 (GSM 02.09 _____ 3.3.3)
Um interface.fact: The network is expected to deny service to any MS that does not support either A5/1 or A5/2 (GSM 02.09 Section 3.3.3). Support of both A5/1 and A5/2 in the MS was mandatory in GSM Phase 2 (GSM 02.07 Section 2) until A5/2 was depreciated by the GSMA in 2006.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Support of both A5/1 and A5/2 in the MS was mandatory in GSM Phase 2 (GSM 02.07 Section 2) until A5/2 was depreciated by the GSMA in _____
Um interface.fact: Support of both A5/1 and A5/2 in the MS was mandatory in GSM Phase 2 (GSM 02.07 Section 2) until A5/2 was depreciated by the GSMA in 2006.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ is assigned by the BSC and is only meaningful within specific network
Um interface.fact: The TMSI is assigned by the BSC and is only meaningful within specific network. The TMSI is assigned by the network with the MM TMSI Reallocation Command, a message that is normally not sent until after ciphering is started, so as to hide the TMSI/IMSI relationship.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Once the _____ is established, it can be used to anonymize future transactions
Um interface.fact: The TMSI is assigned by the BSC and is only meaningful within specific network. The TMSI is assigned by the network with the MM TMSI Reallocation Command, a message that is normally not sent until after ciphering is started, so as to hide the TMSI/IMSI relationship.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The TMSI is assigned by the network with the MM TMSI _____, a message that is normally not sent until after ciphering is started, so as to hide the TMSI/IMSI relationship
Um interface.fact: The TMSI is assigned by the network with the MM TMSI Reallocation Command, a message that is normally not sent until after ciphering is started, so as to hide the TMSI/IMSI relationship.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Note that the subscriber identity must be established before authentication or encryption, so the first transaction in a new network must be initiated by transmitting the _____ in the clear
Um interface.fact: The TMSI is assigned by the network with the MM TMSI Reallocation Command, a message that is normally not sent until after ciphering is started, so as to hide the TMSI/IMSI relationship.
